questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers not to block the intersection ahead. Drivers must obey this rule.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum or minimum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones ahead. Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you a construction zone is starting.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to watch for cattle crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit in bad weather or poor conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crossing your path is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to watch for traffic entering from an upcoming side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is prohibited. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign marks reserved parking spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate. Drivers must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any traffic or pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: These signs tell you the traffic pattern ahead has changed due to a work zone. Follow the indicated detour route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on the road. Obey any instructions from crossing guards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells drivers that they are approaching an area with low clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot make a right turn at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers to be aware of shifting lanes and to follow the new lane path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign indicates that traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road surface is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of workers on or near the roadway. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells drivers that the road will soon become a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns drivers that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a traffic signal is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Be cautious where pedestrians may cross the road.

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
